description_en: Queries the instance migration status list
description_zh: 该接口用于查看实例迁移状态列表
kebab_example: aliyun rds descibe-imports-from-database --db-instance-id rm-bp00000 --engine MySQL --start-time 2023-06-11T15:00Z --end-time 2023-06-11T16:00Z --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescibeImportsFromDatabase

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符，且该参数值中不能包含非ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call DescribeDBInstances to query the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The database engine. Set the value to MySQL
parameters.name: engine

parameters.help_en: The ID of the migration task
parameters.name: import_id

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ (UTC)
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ (UTC)
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page. Valid values:

30
50
100

Default value: 30
parameters.help_zh:
每页记录数。取值：

30
50
100

默认值：30
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The page number. Valid values: any non-zero positive integer that does not exceed the maximum value of the Integer data type.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
页码，取值：大于0且不超过Integer的最大值。

默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The resource group ID. You can call DescribeDBInstanceAttribute to query the resource group ID
parameters.name: resource_group_id

ImportDataStatus.description_en:
The status of the migration task. Valid values:
NotStart: not started
FullExporting: full export in progress
FullImporting: full import in progress
Success: succeeded
Failed: failed
Canceled: canceled
Canceling: canceling
IncrementalWaiting: waiting for incremental synchronization
IncrementalImporting: incremental synchronization in progress
StopSyncing: synchronization stopped
ImportDataStatus.description_zh:
迁移任务状态。取值：
NotStart：未开始
FullExporting：全量导出中
FullImporting：全量导入中
Success：成功
Failed：失败
Canceled：已取消
Canceling：正在取消
IncrementalWaiting：增量同步等待
IncrementalImporting：增量同步中
StopSyncing：停止同步

ImportDataStatusDescription.description_en: The description of the migration task

ImportDataType.description_en:
The type of the migration task. Valid values:
Full: full migration
Incremental: incremental migration
ImportDataType.description_zh:
迁移任务类型。取值：
Full：全量迁移
Incremental：增量迁移

ImportId.description_en: The ID of the migration task

PageRecordCount.description_en: The number of entries per page
